translation_concerns.concern: The printed title is Exercise 9 even though the immutable ID ends in t7. Do not normalize the title to Exercise 7 or change the identity.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Current title and printed_title are Exercise 9; Chinese source metadata and stable identity are untouched.

translation_concerns.concern: The candidate renders 胶木 as Bakelite and 塑料钢笔杆 as plastic pen barrel. Independent English review should confirm these material/object names remain faithful to the approved Chinese rather than substituting a different material or assuming a triboelectric sign.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Task 2 remains an open experiment with no predetermined sign; task 3's mass conclusion remains restricted to electron gain and excluded exchanges.

translation_concerns.concern: Attraction alone must not imply initially opposite charges. Grounding in task 5 is a conditional premise, not a general tool preference or an added procedure. Absence of sliding friction in task 6 must not imply absence of work or energy changes.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Existing teacher guidance, noncontact checks, polarization distinctions, conditional grounding, and possible internal-energy pathways are translated only from the approved Chinese; no new empirical claims, measurements, or safety instructions are introduced.

translation_concerns.concern: The hydrogen estimate must not become a definite classical electron orbit. The extreme water-drop estimate must not become a stable measured state or an experiment to perform; all electrons, not one electron per molecule, are counted.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Classical instantaneous-distance and hypothetical point-charge restrictions are retained. Approximate constants already present in the approved answers/choices are retained only in those corresponding views; none are newly added to the written prompts.

translation_concerns.concern: Relative permittivity remains an unspecified symbolic parameter: epsilon_r in written answers and epsilon in approved choices. The approved epsilon>1 condition appears only in the task 9 choice stem. Task 11 tension is conditional on the given symmetric static geometry and compatible vertical equilibrium.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: No value such as 2.1, sphere mass, volume, density, or small-angle assumption is added. Dividing by the dielectric parameter and the horizontal equilibrium relation are retained.

translation_concerns.concern: The approved modern solutions deliberately differ from original brief answers: task 9 has two positive charges and repulsion before and after contact; task 10's net force points toward the smaller positive source charge; tasks 9 and 11 have no specified kerosene permittivity. Do not use the historical answer to invent a charge sign or parameter.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: All original Chinese bookRaw strings remain exact. English notes preserve the approved Chinese explanations of the discrepancies, without changing the modern conditions or solutions.
